verses.en: Hezekiah began to reign when he was five and twenty years old, and he reigned nine and twenty years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.
verses.sm: Esekia ina ua fai o ia ma tupu, ma ua fai o ia ma tupu i Ierusalema i tausaga e luafulu ma le iva. O Avi le igoa o lona tina, o le afafine o Sakaria.

verses.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that David his father had done.
verses.sm: Sa faia e ia le amiotonu i luma o le ALII, e tusa ma mea uma na faja e Tavita lona tama.

verses.en: He in the first year of his reign, in the first month, opened the doors of the house of the LORD, and repaired them.
verses.sm: O le tausaga muamua o lana nofoaiga i le masina muamua, ua tatalaina e ia o faitotoa o le fale o le ALII, ma na toe teuteu ai.

verses.en: And he brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them together into the east street,
verses.sm: Ua aumaia foi e ia o le au faitaulaga ma sa Levi, ma ua faapotopotoina i latou i le malae i sasae,

verses.en: And said unto them, Hear me, ye Levites, sanctify now yourselves, and sanctify the house of the LORD God of your fathers, and carry forth the filthiness out of the holy place.
verses.sm: ua ia faapea atu foi ia te i latou, O outou o sa Levi, faalogologo mai ia ia te au. Ina faapaiaina ia outou e outou, ma ia outou faapaiaina le fale o le ALII le Atua o outou tamà, ma ia aveeseina mea leaga ai le malumalu.

verses.en: For our fathers have trespassed, and done that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD our God, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of the LORD, and turned their backs.
verses.sm: Aua ua agasala o tatou tama, ma ua fai amio leaga i luma o le Aw: lo tatou Atua; ua latou tuua foi o ia, ma ua liliu ese o latou mata ai le afioaga o le ALII, a ua liliu mai i ai o latou tua.

verses.en: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy place unto the God of Israel.
verses.sm: Ua latou tapuni foi i faitotoa o le faapaologa, ma latou tineia lamepa, ma ua latou le faamuina mea manogi, ua latou le faia foi taulaga mu i le mea paia i le Atua o Isaraelu.

verses.en: Wherefore the wrath of the LORD was upon Judah and Jerusalem, and he hath delivered them to trouble, to astonishment, and to hissing, as ye see with your eyes.
verses.sm: Ua oo mai ai le toasa o le ALII ia Iuta ma Ierusalema, ma ua tuuina atu i latou ia faaatuatuvaleina, ma ia fai ma mea o ofo ai, ma ia uisa ai, e pei ona vaavaai i ai o outou mata.

verses.en: For, lo, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.
verses.sm: Faauta foi, ua fasia o tatou tama i le pelu; o tatou atalii foi, ma o tatou afafine, ma a tatou avā, ua avea faatagataotaua ona o lenei mea.

verses.en: Now it is in mine heart to make a covenant with the LORD God of Israel, that his fierce wrath may turn away from us.
verses.sm: O lenei, o i ai i lo‘u loto e osi le feagaiga ma le ALII le Atua o Isaraelu, ina ia mavae ese ia te i tatou le toasa tele.

verses.en: My sons, be not now negligent: for the LORD hath chosen you to stand before him, to serve him, and that ye should minister unto him, and burn incense.
verses.sm: O lenei, o oʻu atalii e, aua tou te faatamala; aua ua filifilia outou e le ALII tou te tutù i ona luma e auauna ia te ia, ma ia avea outou ma auauna ia te ia, ma faamu ai mea manogi.

verses.en: Then the Levites arose, Mahath the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites: and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehalelel: and of the Gershonites; Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah:
verses.sm: Ona tutu ai lea o sa Levi, o Makata le atalii o Amesai, ma Ioelu le atalii o Asaraia, o isi o le fanauga a sa Koatò; ma ni o le fanauga a Merari; o Kiso le atalii o Opeti, ma Asaraia le atalii o Ialeelu; o lo sa Keresona foi; o Ioaa le atalii o Sema, ma Etena le atalii o Ioaa.

verses.en: And of the sons of Elizaphan; Shimri, and Jeiel: and of the sons of Asaph; Zechariah, and Mattaniah:
verses.sm: O 151 o le fanauga a Elisafano; o Semeri, ma Ieielu; ma nisi o le fanauga a Asafo; o Sakaria, ma Matania;

verses.en: And of the sons of Heman; Jehiel, and Shimei: and of the sons of Jeduthun; Shemaiah, and Uzziel.
verses.sm: ma nisi o le fanauga o Hemana; o Ieielu, ma Semi; ma nisi o le fanauga a Iutana; o Semaia, ma Asielu.

verses.en: And they gathered their brethren, and sanctified themselves, and came, according to the commandment of the king, by the words of the LORD, to cleanse the house of the LORD.
verses.sm: Ua latou faapotopotoina o latou uso, ma ua faapaiaina i latou e i latou, ua o mai i latou e tusa ma le poloaiga a le tupu, i le afioga a le ALI, e faamamā i le fale o le ALII.

verses.en: And the priests went into the inner part of the house of the LORD, to cleanse it, and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of the LORD into the court of the house of the LORD. And the Levites took it, to carry it out abroad into the brook Kidron.
verses.sm: Ona ulu atu lea o le au faitaulaga i totonu o le fale o le ALII e faamamá ai, ma ua latou au mai i le lotoá o le fale o le ALII o mea leaga uma na latou iloa i le malumalu o le ALII. Ona talia ai lea e sa Levi e ave i fafo i le alia o Ketarono.

verses.en: Now they began on the first day of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month came they to the porch of the LORD: so they sanctified the house of the LORD in eight days; and in the sixteenth day of the first month they made an end.
verses.sm: O le aso muamua o le masina muamua na latou amata ai ona faapaiaina, o le aso valu foi o le masina ua latou oo ai i le faapaologa o le fale o le ALII; ua faapaiaina e i latou le fale o le ALII i aso e valu; o le aso e sefulu ma le ono o le masina muamua na faauma ai.

verses.en: Then they went in to Hezekiah the king, and said, We have cleansed all the house of the LORD, and the altar of burnt offering, with all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread table, with all the vessels thereof.
verses.sm: Ona latou ulufale mai lea ia Esekia le tupu, ma ua faapea mai, Ua faamamāina e i matou le fale uma o le ALII, ma le fata e fai ai taulaga mu, ma ona ipu uma, ma le laulau o areto e laulauina i luma, ma ona ipu uma.

verses.en: Moreover all the vessels, which king Ahaz in his reign did cast away in his transgression, have we prepared and sanctified, and, behold, they are before the altar of the LORD.
verses.sm: O ipu uma foi na faaleagaina e le tupu o Aasa i lana nofoaiga i lana agasala, ua matou saunia, ma ua faapaiaina, faauta foi, ua i luma o le fata faitaulaga o le ALII.

verses.en: Then Hezekiah the king rose early, and gathered the rulers of the city, and went up to the house of the LORD.
verses.sm: Ona tulai lea i le taeao lava le tupu o Esekia ma na faapotopotoina alii o le aai, ma latou o ae i le fale o le ALII.

verses.en: And they brought seven bullocks, and seven rams, and seven lambs, and seven he goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, and for the sanctuary, and for Judah. And he commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer them on the altar of the LORD.
verses.sm: Ua latou au mai foi povi e fitu, ma mamoe poa e fitu, ma tamai mamoe e fitu, ma ‘oti poa e fitu, e fai ma taulaga mo le agasala ona o le malo, ma le malumalu, ma Iuta. Ua ia fai atu foi i le au faitaulaga o le fanauga a Arona ia fai ai taulaga mu i luga o le fata faitaulaga o le ALII.

verses.en: So they killed the bullocks, and the priests received the blood, and sprinkled it on the altar: likewise, when they had killed the rams, they sprinkled the blood upon the altar: they killed also the lambs, and they sprinkled the blood upon the altar.
verses.sm: Ona latou fafasi ai lea o povi, ma ua talia le toto e le au faitaulaga, ma sausau ai i le fata faitaulaga; ua latou fafasi foi o mamoe poa, ma ua sausau le fata faitaulaga i le toto; ua latou fafasi foi o tamai mamoe, ma ua sausau le fata faitaulaga i le toto.

verses.en: And they brought forth the he goats for the sin offering before the king and the congregation; and they laid their hands upon them:
verses.sm: Ona latou faalatalata mai ai lea i luma o le tupu ma le faapotopotoga o ‘oti poa e fai ma taulaga mo le agasala; ma latou faaee iai o latou lima;

verses.en: And the priests killed them, and they made reconciliation with their blood upon the altar, to make an atonement for all Israel: for the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering should be made for all Israel.
verses.sm: ona fasi ai lea e le au faitaulaga ma latou fai ai le taulaga mo le agasala i o latou toto i le fata faitaulaga, e togiolaina a“ Isaraelu uma; auā ua fai atu le tupu ia fai le taulaga mu ma le taulaga mo le agasala mo Isaraelu uma.

verses.en: And he set the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals, with psalteries, and with harps, according to the commandment of David, and of Gad the king's seer, and Nathan the prophet: for so was the commandment of the LORD by his prophets.
verses.sm: Ua tofia foi sa Levi i le fale o le ALII ma sumepalo, ma napeli, ma kitara, e tusa ma le poloaiga a Tavita, ma Kato le tagata vaai a le tupu, ma Natano le perofeta; auā sa faapea le poloaiga a le ALII i ana perofeta.

verses.en: And the Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.
verses.sm: Ona tutū lea o sa Levi ma laaupese a Tavita, o le au faitaulaga foi ua i ai pu.

verses.en: And Hezekiah commanded to offer the burnt offering upon the altar. And when the burnt offering began, the song of the LORD began also with the trumpets, and with the instruments ordained by David king of Israel.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu foi Esekia ia fai le taulaga mu i le fata faitaulaga. O le itu la ua amata ai ona fai o le taulaga mu, ua amata ai ona pese i le ALII, ma pu, ma laaupese na saunia e Tavita le tupu o Isaraelu.

verses.en: And all the congregation worshipped, and the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded: and all this continued until the burnt offering was finished.
verses.sm: Ona ifo lea o le faapotopotoga uma, ma ua pepese le au pepese, ma ua ili pu le au ili pu; sa fai pea ja mea uma ina seia uma le taulaga mu.

verses.en: And when they had made an end of offering, the king and all that were present with him bowed themselves, and worshipped.
verses.sm: Ua uma ona fai o le taulaga mu, ona tootuli ai lea o le tupu, ma tagata uma sa faatasi ma ia, ma ua latou ifo.

verses.en: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praise unto the LORD with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. And they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshipped.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu foi Esekia le tupu ma alii i sa Levi ia vivii i le ALII i upu a Tavita, ma Asafo le tagata vaai. Ua latou vivii atu ma le fiafia, ma ua latou punonou ma ifo.

verses.en: Then Hezekiah answered and said, Now ye have consecrated yourselves unto the LORD, come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the house of the LORD. And the congregation brought in sacrifices and thank offerings; and as many as were of a free heart burnt offerings.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Esekia, ua faapea atu, O lenei, ua tofia outou e outou mo le ALII, faalatalata mai ia, ma au mai ai taulaga, ma taulaga faafetai i le fale o le ALII. Ona au mai ai lea e le faapotopotoga o taulaga, ma taulaga faafetai; na au mai ai foi o taulaga mu e i latou uma na manatu i ai o latou loto.

verses.en: And the number of the burnt offerings, which the congregation brought, was threescore and ten bullocks, an hundred rams, and two hundred lambs: all these were for a burnt offering to the LORD.
verses.sm: O le faitau o taulaga mu na au mai e le faapotopotoga, o povi e fitugafulu, o mamoe poa e tasi le selau, ma tamai mamoe e lua selau; o mea uma ia sa fai aЧ taulaga mu i le ALII.

verses.en: And the consecrated things were six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep.
verses.sm: O mea foi sa faasaina o povi e ono selau, ma mamoe e tolu o afe.

verses.en: But the priests were too few, so that they could not flay all the burnt offerings: wherefore their brethren the Levites did help them, till the work was ended, and until the other priests had sanctified themselves: for the Levites were more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.
verses.sm: A ua toaitiiti le au faitaulaga, ua le mafaia ona saeeseina le pau o taulaga mu uma; ona fesoasoani ai lea o latou uso o sa Levi ia te i latou ina seia uma le tofia, ina seia uma foi ona faapaiaina o isi o le au faitaulaga; aua ua sili ona tonu o loto o sa Levi latou te faapaiaina i latou i lo le au faitaulaga.

verses.en: And also the burnt offerings were in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings, and the drink offerings for every burnt offering. So the service of the house of the LORD was set in order.
verses.sm: Ua tele foi taulaga mu, ma le galo o taulaga faafetai, ma taulaga i mea e inu mo taulaga mu taitasi. Ua faapea ona saunia o le galuega o le fale o le ALII.

verses.en: And Hezekiah rejoiced, and all the people, that God had prepared the people: for the thing was done suddenly.
verses.sm: Ua fiafia Esekia atoa ma le nuu uma ina ua saunia le nuu e le Atua; aua sa faafuasei ona fai o lenei mea.
